questionSnapshot.question: Which of these Madrigals does not receive a magical gift in Encanto (2021)?

notes: Removed overbroad only-family-member claim; the in-laws also lack personal gifts. All four are female Madrigals. Medium identification. #1497 asks the song title, not merely Mirabel's gift status.

verification.context: Encanto, Disney 2021 film, restricted to Mirabel, Luisa, Isabela and Julieta listed as answers.

options.reason: Mirabel's individual profile says she did not receive a magical gift.

sources.locator: Individual profiles: Mirabel lacks a gift; Julieta heals through food; Isabela grows plants; Luisa has super strength. Agustin is described separately as marrying into the family.
